title: Vercel
description: Generates a vercel.json for a Next.js application in this workspace: install at the workspace root, nx build, Nx's output directory, and an ignore step that skips deployments when the application isn't affected.

projectName.x-prompt: Which application should get a vercel.json?

ignoreUnaffected.description: Skip the deployment when the commit doesn't affect the application (ignoreCommand with nx-ignore).
